title: Runes and talismans
by: Dev (local model), checked by the writing room

items.name: Rune of the Edge
items.desc: A single straight cut, as sharp as the blade that first carved the mountains. Steel that carries it remembers it was made to cut.

items.name: Rune of the Razor's Edge
items.desc: A mark that whispers of the blade's kiss. Steel that bears it feels the cold of unseen cuts.

items.name: Rune of the Root
items.desc: A mark that branches downward, like the roots of an old tree seeking water. It drinks in the life around it, healing the wielder with each kill and strengthening their resolve in battle.

items.name: Rune of the Deep Branch
items.desc: A gnarled mark that twists and turns like ancient roots, drinking life from the ground and the wielder alike.

items.name: Rune of the Tide
items.desc: Two curves, one returning. It never stops moving, mirroring the ebb and flow of the sea and life itself.

items.name: Rune of the Stone
items.desc: A square inside a square. Heavy to carry, hard to move. This rune offers a shield of stone around its bearer, absorbing blows and cutting through with a weight that leaves the earth trembling.

items.name: Rune of the Cutting Line
items.desc: A single straight cut. Steel that carries it remembers it was made to cut.

items.name: Rune of the Zephyr
items.desc: Three strokes that never quite meet, like the wind that dances around a corner. It whispers to the swift of foot, granting them the grace of the breeze.

items.name: Rune of the Watchful Eye
items.desc: An open eye, carved shut at the corners. It sees the soft places and whispers secrets to those who wear it.

items.name: Rune of the Storm
items.desc: A broken line that stings the hand that carves it. It brings a sudden gale with every strike, and a flash of lightning to the heart of any who cross its path.

items.name: Rune of the Resonant Spirit
items.desc: A delicate mark that hums with an ancient tune. This rune, when infused into a weapon, stirs the qi to strike true and with power, while in armor, it whispers secrets of the deep to those who meditate.

items.name: Rune of the Fallen Star
items.desc: Five points and a tail. Heavier than the stone it's cut in. This rune is said to be a fragment of the celestial bodies that fell to earth ages ago, imbued with the essence of the cosmos.

items.name: Rune of the Abyss
items.desc: Cut into the blank rune as if nothingness itself had carved it. It hums with an absence so profound it feels like it could swallow the world whole.

items.name: Spirit Paper
items.desc: A thin sheet of pressed herb pulp and resin, imbued with the essence of qi. It carries the weight of unseen spirits and whispers of the past.

items.name: Rune of the Ember
items.desc: A mark like a coal's crack. Warm to hold. It whispers of the heat that once burned within it.

items.name: Heavenfire Talisman
items.desc: Written on frozen vellum in ink that never thawed, so the fire has something to fight. It burns down the sky.

items.name: Frost Talisman
items.desc: A sheet of paper painted with the frost of dawn, capturing the chill of the deep valley. When lit, it cools the air around you, slowing and numbing nearby foes.

items.name: Rune of the Tempest
items.desc: A jagged line that breaks the stillness. It whispers of thunder and lightning, cutting and chaos.

items.name: Binding Talisman
items.desc: Threads of qi that hold everything near you where it stands. Ancient warriors used it to ensnare foes, binding them for the briefest of moments.

items.name: Swift Talisman
items.desc: A flicker of wind captured on paper. For thirty breaths, it makes you quick as the morning breeze.

items.name: Ironroot Rune
items.desc: A mark that branches downward like the deep wood of Ironroot Hold. It drinks life from what you defeat to mend your flesh.

items.name: Rune of the Blade
items.desc: A single straight cut. Steel that carries it remembers it was made to cut.

items.name: Talisman of the Revealed Path
items.desc: A sheet of thin spirit paper marked with the arcane symbols of a distant view. Burn it and the veil of the unseen lifts for a time, revealing the map of the floor for all to see.

items.name: Rune of the Celestial Star
items.desc: A mark resembling a shooting star, with five points and a tail. It is said to bring good fortune and strength to those who carry it.

items.name: Seal of the Hidden Gate
items.desc: A parchment with ancient sigils, it glows faintly when the path is uncharted and unseen. For those who dare to pass beyond the known, it whispers secrets of the sealed.
